detailed_description:
The video is a high-end commercial beauty shot with a clean, bright aesthetic, characterized by soft natural daylight and sharp focus on product textures.

[Shot 1] The video begins with the exact frame of <Picture 1>. The camera is positioned in a high-angle close-up over a white tiled bathroom counter. <Subject 1>'s hands are holding <Subject 2>, which is currently open with the coral bullet exposed. As the shot progresses, the fingers of <Subject 1> gently rotate the base of the champagne-metallic casing. The coral lipstick bullet <Subject 2> twists smoothly upward, emerging further from the tube. Simultaneously, a bright, linear window reflection glides across the satin surface of the metallic casing, emphasizing its luxurious sheen. The camera performs a gradual Push In with small amplitude at a slow speed, tightening the frame on the lipstick's texture. In the background, the black sink, the "METRO CITY TRANSIT" card, and the smartphone remain static.

overall_soundscape:
The audio is minimal and crisp, featuring the subtle, mechanical "click" and sliding friction sound of the lipstick mechanism being twisted. There is a faint ambient room tone of a quiet indoor space.
